back_fast.method: Shortest modeled time from each route point to the habitat pixel on the same native graph and corridor (Dijkstra on reversed edges); t_s and o2_l are raw expected values per crew member with no reserve or margin, like back. path is stored only at the route points in path_from (first, last, one every 25 m of route); the way home from another point is the route walked back to the nearest earlier key point, then that path. path is simplified for display (1 m Ramer-Douglas-Peucker, one native pixel); costs use the unsimplified pixel path.

goal_access.reason: the source pixel containing the Observed coordinate is walkable and connected; the route ends at its pixel center

model_note: Scenario: routes use the primary native DTM at 1.011747 m spacing, Horn 3x3 max slope at or below 15°, and directed grades between native source-pixel centers. Fastest or lowest-modeled-hazard optimum is limited to the documented 250 m analysis corridor; terrain factor is 1.0, with no THEMIS sand cost or sample pickup load in this base 15 kg route bucket. Endpoint is a Derived approach goal; no last leg to the Observed stop is modeled.
